summary: Policy templates are consistent for every kind, can be renamed, and can be chosen wherever you delegate.

new.title: Standard and approval templates per kind
new.text: PIM for Groups, Entra ID roles and Azure roles each have a Standard and a RequireApproval template. Azure roles keep exactly the same rules as before.
new.action: Do not roll this environment back to an older version after upgrading; always upgrade forward.

new.title: Rename policy templates safely
new.text: A SuperAdmin can rename any template on the Policy templates page. Rows keep working, because they refer to the template, not its name.

new.title: A default template per kind
new.text: The Policy templates page sets one default for groups, Entra ID roles and Azure roles. A row without a template uses its kind's default.

new.title: Template picker in every wizard
new.text: Every delegation wizard and grid now lets you pick a policy template, showing only templates of the right kind.

new.title: Smaller improvements
new.text: Template packs can only be imported once their workload prerequisites are green, the prerequisite script can enable Microsoft Sentinel, and several workload checks read correctly.
